analysis_item: Reproduce original paper's exact sample split, feature domain, database assumptions, and headline DNA results
purpose: Separate cohort-size, preprocessing, database, and statistical causes of discordance
prerequisite: Obtain exact supplementary/group files and repository versions
stop_condition: Stop if sample/feature mapping cannot be made auditable

analysis_item: Prospectively frozen sensitivity grid for prevalence, pseudocount, distance, QC flag, and permutation strata
purpose: Show which conclusions are stable without threshold shopping
stop_condition: Stop expansion when conclusions stabilize or instability itself is established

analysis_item: Effect-size and uncertainty presentation for diagnosis, alpha diversity, and taxa
purpose: Replace significance-led claims with magnitude and uncertainty

analysis_item: Variance partitioning using only genuinely independent available covariates
purpose: Test whether date/cohort/QC explains more than diagnosis
stop_condition: Do not fit uninterpretable high-dimensional models

analysis_item: Create external oral-reference set before inspecting outcome associations
purpose: Avoid constructing a score from the five significant taxa
prerequisite: Written selection rule based on paired oral/BAL primary literature or independent oral reference data
stop_condition: Stop if taxonomy cannot be harmonized prospectively

analysis_item: Validate reference set against released negative controls and known oral-background contrasts
purpose: Separate oral-like signal from reagent/background signal
prerequisite: Access processed controls and compatible taxonomic labels
stop_condition: Stop if oral set tracks controls/classified fraction more strongly than biology

analysis_item: Test continuous oral signal against diagnosis with compositional and QC safeguards
purpose: Assess whether continuous ecology explains variation beyond diagnosis
stop_condition: Stop if signal is not robust to QC/classified fraction and cohort/date

analysis_item: Use independent paired upper/lower-airway datasets for construct validation
purpose: Verify the score measures mouth–lung similarity rather than arbitrary anaerobe abundance
stop_condition: Do not pool incompatible specimen types

analysis_item: Associate oral signal with independent host RNA or inflammatory readout
purpose: Move beyond taxonomy toward biological relevance
prerequisite: Prespecified host endpoint not copied from Han et al.
stop_condition: Stop if patient-level DNA–RNA mapping or host endpoints are unavailable

analysis_item: Audit patient-level pairing, RNA library nature, negative controls, processed matrices, and overlap with Han et al.
purpose: Determine whether a distinct question is technically possible
stop_condition: Stop if microbial RNA cannot be distinguished from assay/detectability effects

analysis_item: Prospectively define one DNA–RNA activity question and null model
purpose: Prevent pathway fishing and distinguish detection from activity
prerequisite: Question must not duplicate Han's RNA taxa or diagnostic modeling
stop_condition: NO-GO if no independent endpoint exists

analysis_item: Cohort-wide paired DNA–RNA taxon/gene analysis with negative-control and depth safeguards
purpose: Test relative transcription beyond DNA abundance
stop_condition: Stop for pervasive RNA dropout/dispersion or irreproducible mapping

purpose: Test whether an activity signature behaves similarly in paired airway WGS/RNA data
stop_condition: Do not call small healthy-smoker data clinical validation

purpose: Original paper already developed and internally tested multimodal models
prerequisite: Independent cohort and distinct target would be mandatory
stop_condition: Do not proceed in current phase
